items.t: Coca-Cola Consolidated (COKE) Stock Is Up 5.9% Today Without Company News
items.sum: Coca-Cola Consolidated shares rose 5.9% on Wednesday, Nov. 25, without company-specific news, as the S&P 500 fell 2.9% in a tech-led selloff.
